site_name: Land To The West Of Corner Mead And North Of Satchell Mead (Grahame Park North East)LondonNW9
description: Non-material amendments to planning permission reference 25/3588/OUT dated 21/08/26 for 'Outline planning application (with access, appearance, landscaping, layout and scale reserved) for the demolition of 156 existing residential units, buildings and associated structures to enable the phased redevelopment of the site (including Phase 0 enabling preliminary works) to deliver 463 new residential units (Use Class C3) and up to 645 sqm (GEA) of commercial floor space (Use Class E (a/ b)), within buildings ranging in 2 to 21 storeys in height, with associated public open space, hard and soft landscaping, public realm, creation of new and alteration to existing access, car and cycle parking provisions, sustainable drainage systems, re-levelling and other associated works. This application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement.' Amendments include: Changes to the tree removal parameter plan; Changes to the wording of condition 32 (Temporary Drainage Condition (Construction Phase))
